Amelia CSM: Theta sent a formal onboarding request for theta-legal-14b (14B contract summarizer). Requirements: BYOK via AWS CloudHSM, US-WEST-2 residency, 90d audit logs, and an eval on their 5k contract corpus. They
sked if we can pilot in ~3 weeks.

Rafael Sec: BYOK noted. Need their CloudHSM cluster endpoint, SOC/ISO docs, network diagram, and key rotation plan before security signoff.

Li Safety: We'll run PHI/PII extraction recall, redaction robustness, and hallucination checks on legal Q&A. Requesting 200 de-identified docs + 50 high-risk QA pairs to build safety bench. Label: theta-legal-safety-v1.

Jon ML: Model format? If PyTorch weights, we can stage quickly. Also please share a sample inference config (batch, max_tokens).

Amelia CSM: They provided: format=pt, batch=4, max_tokens=512. Peak expected 30-40 rps, avg ~8-10 rps, target p95 <350ms.

Priya Eng: Rollout sketch: security intake (0-3d) -> staging deploy + eval (4-9d) -> canary ramp (10-14d) -> pilot monitoring (15-21d). Fallback to redwood-legal-7b on issues.

Rafael Sec: Creating ticket and collecting artifacts. This is a renewal-watch item (renewal Aug 2026) .

OpsBot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421 https://redwood.example/tickets/REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421

Amelia CSM: Action items: Rafael collect security docs, Li draft eval checklist, Priya prepare rollout steps, Jon prep staging infra. I'll request the de-id samples and schedule an enablement call for next Tue 10am PT.
